body.statement: Under the constant-rank conditions, \(\phi_U^{\mathrm{loc}}(P;b,P_0)\in\mathcal I_b(P)\) for every \(P\in\mathcal M_b\) in a neighborhood of \(P_0\), and \(\phi_U^{\mathrm{loc}}(P_0;\mathrm{PT},P_0)=\phi_U^{\mathrm{loc}}(P_0;\mathrm{SC},P_0)=\phi_U(P_0)\). Along every \(((P_n,b_n))\in\mathfrak L_U(P_0)\) for which both chart labels are admissible, the \(L^2(P_{n,O})\) distance between the PT and SC extensions is \(O(n^{-1/2})\).
body.justification: The lemma supplies a branch-valid and center-coherent score on PT-only and SC-only local sequences, so the attainment target never invokes an intersection-only object off the intersection.
body.gap: SunXieZhang2025 gives separate branch scores, but does not construct a fixed-rank continuation from their common intersection score into both local charts.
body.consumer: The chart extension is the score target needed for one branch-robust interval under local switching in the Alaska and sugary-drink-tax panels.
